summary.text: Defonsio Daniels is an independent write-in candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 180 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Steven Sainz.
A Marine Corps veteran with a law enforcement background, he also ran in the 2026 Democratic primary for Georgia's 1st Congressional District and lost.

paragraphs.text: Defonsio Daniels was born in Gainesville, Florida, graduated from Eastside High School and served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2001 to 2007, according to Ballotpedia.
The site lists his profession as law enforcement.
In a 2025 Ballotpedia survey for his congressional campaign, he described himself as a Marine veteran and retired law enforcement officer who later moved into federal law enforcement.
Daniels ran in the Democratic primary for Georgia's 1st Congressional District and lost on May 19, 2026, before running as an independent write-in for the state House.
In the 2025 survey, he said he supports Medicaid expansion, affordable housing, public health and mental health supports, and regular town hall meetings and transparent reporting to residents.
